{
  "candidate_rtl": "module pw_fast_add #(
    parameter WIDTH = 32,
    parameter SUB = 0
)(
    input wire [WIDTH-1:0] a, b,
    output wire [WIDTH-1:0] s
);
    localparam GROUPS = (WIDTH+3)/4;
    localparam LEVELS = $clog2(GROUPS);
    wire [WIDTH-1:0] bb, p, g;
    wire [GROUPS-1:0] gp [0:LEVELS];
    wire [GROUPS-1:0] gg [0:LEVELS];
    wire [GROUPS-1:0] block_c;
    assign bb = b ^ {WIDTH{SUB != 0}};
    assign p = a ^ bb;
    assign g = a & bb;

    genvar k, j, l, i, t;
    generate
        for (k = 0; k < GROUPS; k = k+1) begin: groups
            localparam LO = 4*k;
            localparam N = ((WIDTH-LO) >= 4) ? 4 : (WIDTH-LO);
            wire [N-1:0] terms;
            assign gp[0][k] = &p[LO+N-1:LO];
            for (j = 0; j < N; j = j+1) begin: group_terms
                if (j == N-1) begin: last_term
                    assign terms[j] = g[LO+j];
                end else begin: earlier_term
                    assign terms[j] = g[LO+j] & (&p[LO+N-1:LO+j+1]);
                end
            end
            assign gg[0][k] = |terms;
        end
        for (l = 0; l < LEVELS; l = l+1) begin: prefix_levels
            for (k = 0; k < GROUPS; k = k+1) begin: nodes
                if (k >= (1 << l)) begin: combine
                    assign gp[l+1][k] = gp[l][k] & gp[l][k-(1 << l)];
                    assign gg[l+1][k] = gg[l][k] | (gp[l][k] & gg[l][k-(1 << l)]);
                end else begin: pass_node
                    assign gp[l+1][k] = gp[l][k];
                    assign gg[l+1][k] = gg[l][k];
                end
            end
        end
        for (k = 0; k < GROUPS; k = k+1) begin: block_carries
            if (k == 0) begin: first
                assign block_c[k] = (SUB != 0);
            end else begin: subsequent
                assign block_c[k] = gg[LEVELS][k-1] | (gp[LEVELS][k-1] & (SUB != 0));
            end
        end
        for (i = 0; i < WIDTH; i = i+1) begin: sum_bits
            localparam LO = (i/4)*4;
            if (i == LO) begin: first_bit
                assign s[i] = p[i] ^ block_c[i/4];
            end else begin: other_bit
                wire [i-LO-1:0] terms;
                wire carry_in;
                for (t = LO; t < i; t = t+1) begin: carry_terms
                    if (t == i-1) begin: last_term
                        assign terms[t-LO] = g[t];
                    end else begin: earlier_term
                        assign terms[t-LO] = g[t] & (&p[i-1:t+1]);
                    end
                end
                assign carry_in = (|terms) | ((&p[i-1:LO]) & block_c[i/4]);
                assign s[i] = p[i] ^ carry_in;
            end
        end
    endgenerate
endmodule

module pw_alu #(
    parameter WIDTH = 64
)(
    input wire [WIDTH-1:0] a, b,
    input wire [2:0] Oper,
    output reg [WIDTH-1:0] sum
);
    wire [WIDTH-1:0] add_result, ab_result, ba_result;
    pw_fast_add #(.WIDTH(WIDTH), .SUB(0)) add_unit (
        .a(a), .b(b), .s(add_result)
    );
    pw_fast_add #(.WIDTH(WIDTH), .SUB(1)) ab_unit (
        .a(a), .b(b), .s(ab_result)
    );
    pw_fast_add #(.WIDTH(WIDTH), .SUB(1)) ba_unit (
        .a(b), .b(a), .s(ba_result)
    );
    always @* begin
        case (Oper)
            3'b000: sum = add_result;
            3'b001: sum = ab_result;
            3'b010: sum = ba_result;
            3'b011: sum = a | b;
            3'b100: sum = a & b;
            3'b101: sum = a ^ b;
            3'b110: sum = a ~^ b;
            default: sum = {WIDTH{1'b0}};
        endcase
    end
endmodule

module pw_pipeline_alu #(
    parameter WIDTH = 32,
    parameter STAGES = 2
)(
    input wire clk, rst,
    input wire [WIDTH-1:0] a, b,
    input wire [2:0] Oper,
    input wire in_valid,
    output wire [WIDTH-1:0] result,
    output wire out_valid
);
    reg [WIDTH-1:0] operand_a, operand_b;
    reg [2:0] opcode;
    reg input_valid;
    wire [WIDTH-1:0] alu_result;
    wire [WIDTH-1:0] stage_data [0:STAGES-2];
    wire stage_valid [0:STAGES-2];

    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (rst) begin
            operand_a <= 0;
            operand_b <= 0;
            opcode <= 0;
            input_valid <= 0;
        end else begin
            operand_a <= a;
            operand_b <= b;
            opcode <= Oper;
            input_valid <= in_valid;
        end
    end

    pw_alu #(.WIDTH(WIDTH)) alu (
        .a(operand_a), .b(operand_b), .Oper(opcode), .sum(alu_result)
    );

    genvar index;
    generate
        for (index = 0; index < STAGES-1; index = index+1) begin: output_pipeline
            reg [WIDTH-1:0] data_reg;
            reg valid_reg;
            wire [WIDTH-1:0] next_data;
            wire next_valid;
            if (index == 0) begin: first_stage
                assign next_data = alu_result;
                assign next_valid = input_valid;
            end else begin: following_stage
                assign next_data = stage_data[index-1];
                assign next_valid = stage_valid[index-1];
            end
            always @(posedge clk) begin
                if (rst) begin
                    data_reg <= 0;
                    valid_reg <= 0;
                end else begin
                    data_reg <= next_data;
                    valid_reg <= next_valid;
                end
            end
            assign stage_data[index] = data_reg;
            assign stage_valid[index] = valid_reg;
        end
    endgenerate
    assign result = stage_data[STAGES-2];
    assign out_valid = stage_valid[STAGES-2];
endmodule",
  "bottleneck": "The likely optimization target is the registered-operand-to-registered-result arithmetic and selection cone. Baseline paths contain substantial control buffering and several carry-like logic levels; mapped names alone do not establish which operation dominates.",
  "rewrite": "Replace the three inferred arithmetic operators with parallel four-bit-group carry-lookahead adders. Group carries use a logarithmic parallel-prefix network, and intra-group carries use explicit lookahead equations. Subtraction uses complemented second operands and an initial carry of one. Opcode selection remains after arithmetic, avoiding opcode-controlled inversion on the carry path. Preserve the entire original register structure and names.",
  "expected_timing_gain": "The bounded local carry depth and three-level group prefix at WIDTH=32 are intended to improve setup WNS over the 7.17 ns baseline. No mapped timing run is available here, so an improvement or numerical gain cannot be certified.",
  "area_or_other_cost": "No registers or pipeline stages are added. Explicit lookahead introduces parallel carry logic and wiring, partly offset by shared Boolean expressions during synthesis. Compliance with the 10341.668480 um2 area cap and library electrical limits requires evaluation; no measured area or electrical result is claimed.",
  "functional_boundaries": "All arithmetic is unsigned modulo 2^WIDTH. All seven operations and opcode 111's zero default are retained. The helper supports positive WIDTH values, including partial final groups; the pipeline retains the reference STAGES structure for STAGES >= 2. Source and mapped equivalence still require the specified checks."
